name: Yuki MCP
description_en: Book invoices, journal entries and archive documents in Yuki over its SOAP API — it writes as well as reads, and starts from a node path because the package ships no npx entry point.
description_nl: Boek facturen, memoriaalposten en archiefdocumenten in Yuki via de SOAP API — de server muteert en leest, en start via een node-pad omdat het pakket geen npx-ingang meelevert.
subject: yuki
